sources: PJ Ace ad audio patterns (HSP — hook, story, payoff)
ElevenLabs voice library + Sound Generation API
_meta.principle: Veo audio is OFF by default ($0.20/s vs $0.40/s with audio). Audio is mixed externally via tools/pipelines/audio/mix.mjs. This file maps SHOT INTENT to a layered audio recipe (VO + SFX + music bed) the mixer can ingest.
consumed_by: tools/pipelines/audio/mix.mjs — manifest layers consume these recipes
tools/pipelines/video/manifests/_schema.json — assembly.audio_path can be replaced by an audio-recipe key (Phase 2.11 additive)

rules.vo_above_music_db: VO peaks must sit ≥10 dB above music bed RMS. HR-ad calibration: VO peaks at -12 to -15 dB, music at -27 to -30 dB.
rules.loudnorm_target: I=-16 LUFS broadcast standard. Apply via ffmpeg loudnorm filter after mix.
rules.sfx_timing: Hit on the visual beat, not before. SFX leading the visual by even 100ms reads as 'wrong'.
rules.wake_word_lead: VO start_s must match the actual mouth-open frame, not the shot boundary. Probe sample frames before scheduling.
